professions.name: Smith
professions.desc: The anvil teaches patience: every piece finished makes the next cleaner and less likely to spoil.

professions.name: Alchemist
professions.desc: A steady hand at the cauldron wastes fewer herbs and draws more out of every root.

professions.name: Miner
professions.desc: The vein teaches the eye: a practiced miner reads richer stone, and rank fills the sack faster.

professions.name: Herbalist
professions.desc: The garden teaches the hand: a practiced herbalist cuts without bruising, and rank fills the basket faster.

professions.name: Formationist
professions.desc: Arrays are arguments made of jade and wire: every disc seated makes the next pattern truer.

professions.name: Processor
professions.desc: Raw is a promise, not a product: the processor's craft is turning harvest and kill into what brewers actually need.
